title: Single hieratic sign, Turin, Museo Egizio, S. 17507/2 (AKU HT 37369)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Kyra van der Moezel; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 37369

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 37369; AKU grapheme D0810 (AKU GR 173). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: D58 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 124. Occurrence: find place Gebelein; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "rot"; sign size 3.4 x 2.7 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Altes Reich, 4. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Kyra van der Moezel. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
